name: darrenxhays
description: darrenxhays skills: build, message and pragmatic-engineer, with pragmatic-engineer also linked into Codex and used for every planning and coding task

auto_use.title: Use pragmatic-engineer automatically
auto_use.description: Give every Claude session pragmatic-engineer's instructions, and tell Codex (in ~/.codex/AGENTS.md) to use it, for planning and coding. Off: call it yourself with /darrenxhays:pragmatic-engineer. A project can override this for its Claude sessions with PRAGMATIC_ENGINEER_AUTO_USE in its settings env (helm's CONFIG panel sets it). Takes effect in new sessions.

message_auto_use.title: Use message automatically
message_auto_use.description: Let Claude use the message skill on its own whenever it writes a message for you to send, putting it on the clipboard. Off: messages stay in Claude's reply, and you call it yourself with /darrenxhays:message. Takes effect in new sessions.
